children: Mustang received a second 180-day Nasdaq grace period to regain the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement.
Nasdaq notified Mustang that its stock closed below $1.00 for 30 consecutive business days, triggering noncompliance with the $1.00 bid rule.
Mustang used its initial 180-day cure period (ended Oct 12, 2026) but did not demonstrate compliance and requested a second 180-day period.
Nasdaq granted the additional period until Apr 12, 2027; compliance requires a $1.00+ closing bid for at least 10 consecutive business days.
Mustang may effect a reverse stock split to regain compliance but warned there is no assurance it will meet listing requirements.
